<div class="hero-text">

<div class="hero-name">Lasanthi Watagoda</div>

<div class="hero-role">
Associate Professor of Statistics<br>
Department of Mathematical Sciences · Appalachian State University
</div>

<div class="hero-intro">

I am a statistician and educator with interests spanning **statistical learning, regression, variable selection, bootstrap methods, and applied statistics**. My work brings together methodological research, statistical computing, and student-centered teaching.

</div>

## About Me {.section-title}

<div class="bio-card">

I received my <span class="degree">Ph.D. in Mathematics</span> from the Department of Mathematics at **Southern Illinois University Carbondale** in August 2017.

I am currently an **Associate Professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Appalachian State University**, where my work centers on statistics, statistical learning, research, and teaching.
